subject: Require Pi 0.99.1 and admit codemode's nested calls under routing

seeded.defect: The gate's first nested-call check drops its isRouting operand, so every nested call is refused with 'Call <name> directly, not from a script.', including ordinary tools such as read that scripts may call under routing.
seeded.original_line: if (isRouting && nested) return { block: true, reason: `Call ${name} directly, not from a script.` };
seeded.seeded_line: if (nested) return { block: true, reason: `Call ${name} directly, not from a script.` };

proof.seeded_result: pass 1, fail 2, exit 1. Failing: 'under automatic routing a nested call is admitted with its issuing call' and 'a worker's nested read is admitted while its assignment is outstanding', both at the nested read's isError assertion (true !== false) with text 'Call read directly, not from a script.'

seeded.notes: The candidate note proposed a lexical Pi version comparison (0.99.10 sorting before 0.99.1). This commit has no runtime version comparison: its only version change is package.json (peerDependencies and devDependencies moved to 0.99.1). A version-compare seed would have to add new code, so the seed is this routing-guard condition instead. Class is still logic.

environment_notes: node_modules: symlinked read-only from the worktree (no npm install). It holds @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 1.0.1; this commit pins a different Pi version (see pinned_pi), so results were produced against 1.0.1.
Final proof run: a fresh git archive of the base commit per variant, with the fixture's workspace/files/ copied on top, then the command run from the export root.

tsc (node_modules/.bin/tsc -p pi-extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit) reports two errors on clean and identically on seeded: quickjs-emscripten-core and @jitl/quickjs-wasmfile-release-sync are missing from the worktree's node_modules. This is environment, not the change. The seeded src was also compiled with --noEmitOnError false and the seeded line appears in the compiled output.
unsure: No version-compare defect exists in this commit (see notes). If the suite owner wants a version-comparison case, it needs a different base change.
